details: US President Donald Trump announced on TruthSocial that an agreement with Iran has been "largely negotiated" and is subject to finalization, which would include the opening of the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iranian state media, Fars News, has since disputed the claim regarding the reopening of the key maritime shipping lane, reiterating that the Strait of Hormuz will remain under Iranian control according to their latest proposal. This development renews hopes for an end to the ongoing conflict but highlights continued points of contention.
title: Trump Claims US-Iran Deal 'Largely Negotiated' Amid Hormuz Dispute

details: Bitcoin experienced a price increase following President Trump's announcement of a peace agreement with Iran. This diplomatic breakthrough suggests a potential US-Iran nuclear deal before 2027. Prediction markets have shown a significant increase in the likelihood of such an agreement and Iran surrendering its enriched uranium stockpile, indicating a more favorable environment for resolving long-standing nuclear tensions.
title: Bitcoin Rises After Trump Announces Iran Peace Agreement

details: Wall Street saw fresh highs with the Dow Jones Industrial Average reaching new record levels amidst a general calming of geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding Iran. This positive market sentiment was also influenced by the appointment of Kevin Warsh as the new independent Federal Reserve Chairman, who has pledged reform and growth. While general market gains were noted, the direct impact on cryptocurrencies was not explicitly detailed, but a stable global economic environment often provides a favorable backdrop for digital assets.
title: Global Markets See Gains as Geopolitical Tensions Calm, Fed Chair Appointed
